office_does: A District Court judge presides over most criminal misdemeanor cases in Whatcom County, plus protection orders, small claims and therapeutic courts such as Mental Health Court.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Judge Angela Anderson, on the bench since October 2021, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: District Court judge since October 2021 and a Whatcom County public defender for 13 years before that; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: District Court judge since October 2021; Whatcom County public defender 2006-2019 [S1]
Presides over Mental Health Court and cites creating Family Justice Court for domestic-violence cases [S1][S2]
Received 123 DUI cases in 2023 after a Superior Court writ removed them from Judge Rands [S4]
